disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean, SD and range of total mercury in 60 cans of tuna in oil from three Quito supermarket brands.

study.design: retail survey, 20 cans from different batches for each of three brands
study.origin: not stated (species and catch area not labelled)
study.market: supermarkets, south and north Quito, Ecuador
study.qa: procedural blanks, replicates (n=15), DORM-4 every 10 samples; precision and accuracy stated within AOAC SMPR 2012.007 limits (values not printed)

findings.material_label: Canned solid tuna in oil, drained edible portion
findings.group: canned solid tuna in oil, supermarket brand A (lowest price), Quito
findings.notes: Measured by DMA on lyophilized edible portion (packing oil removed); the paper does not state whether mg/kg is per dry or wet weight, though it compares with wet-weight limits.
